diff_table.desired_state: Select agency shim cleanup as the next post-pilot boundary. The next implementation task should remove only agency compatibility shims, update shim/parity tests and file-structure evidence, and prove no public package command, package entrypoint, adapter schema/tool behavior, direct Node execution, package loading, or product behavior changes.
diff_table.rationale: Closing the pilot lifecycle is lower blast radius than moving audit/build/validation/session/roadmap/state/project while temporary agency shims still exist. TASK-015 named shim cleanup as the remaining risk, and TASK-018 now guarantees satisfied deferrals cannot remain hidden.
diff_table.risk: medium: removing source files can break undocumented deep imports, so the follow-up task must prove internal imports are gone and package/public surfaces remain stable.
